objective: Freeze and certify the v0.5.0 package release metadata without changing scientific behavior or weakening the release gates.

baseline.status: Scientifically validated release candidate; package version and changelog are being frozen for v0.5.0.

correctness.before: v0.5.0 package metadata was not yet frozen
correctness.after: package metadata and changelog identify the same intended v0.5.0 release

reproducibility.after: version and scientific-status notes are committed to the release branch

reliability.before: release candidate lacked final package-version freeze
reliability.after: release automation can validate the frozen v0.5.0 version

evidence: This change only freezes package metadata and release documentation.
Heavy source-backed Scientific Validation already passed on the release candidate.
The unresolved exact CPVS reconstruction remains explicitly external-only and is not reclassified by this release-preparation change.

root_causes: The initial CI run for PR-146 failed because the cumulative lifecycle gate requires a machine-readable cycle record for every meaningful pull request.

findings: Release-only documentation and version changes still require an executable cumulative lifecycle record.
Release metadata must not be used to conceal unresolved external historical reproduction claims.

open_blockers: PR-146 CI must pass after this lifecycle record is corrected.
The v0.5.0 tag and GitHub release must only be created after the final gated main revision is verified.
